This document outlines the equipment inspection 
 I1, which must be performed on monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Zakaria 
 Mohamed Abdel-Rahem, tested by eng. Osama Ahmed Hasanen, accepted by eng. 
 Mahmoud Abdel-Daiem: general director at Aswan Dam 1 Power Station, approved 
 by eng. Khalaf Allah Mahmoud Abdel-Gaber: Head sector, and certified by 
 eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC quality control general director & MPIS 
 Coordinator

items: A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable ID safety category.

Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the personal protective 
 equipment must used as safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc
Retighten the terminals in control cubicle.
Check input voltage (220 Vac) and output voltage (24Vdc).
Check the detectors for all four zones.

Simulate the alarm by using special spray and record the acoustic alarm and 
 RED LED at this zone.
Repeat step (4) at every at every zone and acknowledge the alarm.
Finally check there is no RED LED alarm at any zone.
Check the battery, which should be changed every three years.

text:
Power Stations | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection 
 I1, which must be performed on monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Zakaria 
 Mohamed Abdel-Rahem, tested by eng. Osama Ahmed Hasanen, accepted by eng. 
 Mahmoud Abdel-Daiem: general director at Aswan Dam 1 Power Station, approved 
 by eng. Khalaf Allah Mahmoud Abdel-Gaber: Head sector, and certified by 
 eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC quality control general director & MPIS 
 Coordinator
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable ID safety category.
Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the personal protective 
 equipment must used as safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc
Tools and Equipment
Special Spray for test
Screw Drivers
Special Spray for test
Screw Drivers
Work to be Carried Out
Retighten the terminals in control cubicle.
Check input voltage (220 Vac) and output voltage (24Vdc).
Check the detectors for all four zones.
Simulate the alarm by using special spray and record the acoustic alarm and 
 RED LED at this zone.
Repeat step (4) at every at every zone and acknowledge the alarm.
Finally check there is no RED LED alarm at any zone.
Check the battery, which should be changed every three years.
